visit_note.summary: Seasonal rhinitis symptoms each spring. Penicillin allergy confirmed in record.
visit_note.plan: Daily non-drowsy antihistamine in season, saline rinse.

visit_note.summary: Brief dizziness when standing. Orthostatic BP drop is mild. ECG normal.
visit_note.plan: Increase fluids and salt slightly, rise slowly. No further cardiac testing required.

visit_note.summary: Echo and ECG ordered after hypertension diagnosis. Heart structure appears normal.
visit_note.plan: Continue GP-managed therapy, return for stress test.

visit_note.summary: Tension-type headaches 2-3 times weekly linked to screen time and poor sleep. Neurological exam normal.
visit_note.plan: Regular breaks, hydration, sleep routine. Ibuprofen only when needed. Keep a headache diary.

visit_note.summary: Elevated BP readings at home averaging 145/92. No symptoms.
visit_note.plan: Start low-dose ACE inhibitor, referral to cardiology, lifestyle advice.

visit_note.summary: HbA1c 6.9%. Feet exam normal. Diet good.
visit_note.plan: Continue metformin, annual eye exam, walk 30 minutes daily.

visit_note.summary: Two to three migraines a month with visual aura lasting 20 minutes. Neurological exam normal.
visit_note.plan: Headache diary, triptan at onset, avoid estrogen-containing contraception.

visit_note.summary: Dry, cracked patches on both hands since starting a lab job. No infection.
visit_note.plan: Fragrance-free emollient after every wash, mild steroid cream for 7 days, nitrile gloves at work.

visit_note.summary: Right shoulder pain on overhead movement after moving furniture. Full range, painful arc at 90 degrees.
visit_note.plan: Physiotherapy referral, ice after activity, avoid overhead lifting for 3 weeks.

visit_note.summary: Low mood for 6 weeks after a job change, waking at 4am. No thoughts of self-harm.
visit_note.plan: Weekly talking therapy, sleep routine, daily walk. Review in two weeks.

visit_note.summary: Occasional palpitations, ECG normal. Likely linked to caffeine and stress.
visit_note.plan: Reduce caffeine, 24h Holter monitor arranged.

visit_note.summary: BP 128/82 today, improved from 142/90. Home log shows good control on current dose.
visit_note.plan: Continue current medication. Reduce sodium. Recheck in 3 months.

visit_note.summary: Dry cough for 2 weeks, no fever. Lungs clear on examination.
visit_note.plan: Honey and fluids, avoid irritants. Return if symptoms last beyond 3 more weeks.

visit_note.summary: Healthy 14-year-old, growth on track. Heart and lungs normal.
visit_note.plan: No restrictions. Keep inhaler in sports bag.

visit_note.summary: Facial pressure and congestion for 9 days, mild fever earlier in the week.
visit_note.plan: Saline rinses, nasal steroid spray for 2 weeks. Antibiotics only if worse after 3 days.

visit_note.summary: Stress test normal to target heart rate. No ischemic changes.
visit_note.plan: Continue current therapy with GP. No cardiology follow-up needed.

visit_note.summary: Asthma well controlled, using reliever twice a month. Inhaler technique good.
visit_note.plan: Repeat preventer inhaler for 6 months.

visit_note.summary: Seasonal flu vaccine given. Latex-free gloves used.
visit_note.plan: No further action.

visit_note.summary: Feels well. BP 124/80, BMI 26. Non-smoker.
visit_note.plan: Fasting bloods for cholesterol, aim for 150 minutes of exercise a week.

visit_note.summary: Iron slightly low, kidney function stable for age.
visit_note.plan: Iron supplement every other day, recheck bloods in 8 weeks.

visit_note.summary: Twelve moles checked with dermatoscope. All regular.
visit_note.plan: Sun protection, self-check monthly, photo one mole on the back for comparison.

visit_note.summary: Vaccines given to 4-year-old grandson, no reaction after 15 minutes.
visit_note.plan: Paracetamol if feverish tonight. Next vaccines at age 5.

visit_note.summary: Tightness only in cold air, resolves within minutes. ECG normal, peak flow drops after exercise.
visit_note.plan: Reliever inhaler 15 minutes before running. Referred back to GP.

visit_note.summary: Left knee aches after walking more than 20 minutes. Mild swelling, no locking.
visit_note.plan: Paracetamol as needed, strengthening exercises, orthopedics referral if no better in 6 weeks.

visit_note.summary: Afternoon headaches on workdays, eyes strained. Exam normal.
visit_note.plan: Eye test, screen breaks every 45 minutes, posture check.

visit_note.summary: LDL 3.9 mmol/L, 10-year risk low.
visit_note.plan: Diet changes first, recheck lipids in 3 months.

visit_note.summary: Travelling to Ghana in 5 weeks. Peanut allergy noted, carries auto-injector.
visit_note.plan: Yellow fever and typhoid vaccines given today, malaria tablets prescribed.

visit_note.summary: Poor sleep and racing thoughts before final exams. Coping, good support from friends.
visit_note.plan: Breathing exercises, limit caffeine after 2pm, student counselling referral.

workflows.title: Reserve the doctor's slot when an appointment is booked

do.code: await ctx.db.create('slot', { appointment_id: String(row.id), doctor_id: String(row.doctor_id), starts_at: row.starts_at, ends_at: row.ends_at, active: true });

workflows.title: Keep the slot in step when an appointment moves or is cancelled

do.code: const all = await ctx.db.list('slot'); const s = all.find((x) => String(x.appointment_id) === String(row.id)); if (s) { await ctx.db.update('slot', String(s.id), { starts_at: row.starts_at, ends_at: row.ends_at, active: String(row.status) !== 'cancelled' }); }

workflows.title: Hourly: remind patients of appointments in the next 24 hours

do.code: const now = ctx.now().getTime(); const WD = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat']; const MO = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']; const rows = await ctx.db.list('appointment'); let n = 0; for (const a of rows) { const t = new Date(String(a.starts_at)).getTime(); if (String(a.status) === 'booked' && !a.reminded && t > now && t - now <= 86400000) { const d = new Date(t); const when = WD[d.getUTCDay()] + ' ' + d.getUTCDate() + ' ' + MO[d.getUTCMonth()] + ' at ' + String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'); const prep = a.prep_notes ? ' ' + String(a.prep_notes) : ' Please arrive 10 minutes early.'; await ctx.db.create('reminder', { appointment_id: String(a.id), patient_id: String(a.patient_id), message: String(a.reason) + ' with ' + String(a.doctor_name) + ', ' + when + '.' + prep }); await ctx.db.update('appointment', String(a.id), { reminded: true }); n++; } } ctx.log('reminders created: ' + n);
